Pricing FAQ

Questions about plans.

Anything else? Ask on your demo.

What is a buyer question?

A question a shopper asks AI before buying, like “best waterproof hiking jacket under $200”. Produkto writes them from your catalog when you set up, and you can edit them anytime.

Why price by questions and not by products?

The work is asking AI your buyer questions every day, so that is what we charge for. Every product in your catalog is included on every plan, whether you sell 50 or 5,000.

Which plan do I need?

Starter suits a brand competing in one main product category. Growth leaves room for several. Not sure? Book a demo and we’ll size it with you.

What happens after I pay?

You get a link to set your password, then add your store, check your brand details and review your buyer questions. Daily scans start from there.

Can I track more than one store?

Each account covers one store. If you run several, book a demo and we’ll set it up with you.

Can I change plan or cancel?

Plans are billed monthly. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard. To change plan, email kelian@getprodukto.com.
